name: Chest Catch
description: Receive and secure a sliotar safely against the chest while maintaining balance and awareness.

name: Hook
description: Disrupt an opponent's ground strike by applying a controlled hook to the opponent's hurley.

name: Dribble
description: Move the sliotar along the ground under control using short touches with the hurley.

name: Frontal Ground Block
description: Block an opponent's ground strike from the front using safe body position and hurley placement.

name: Overhead Catch
description: Track and secure a high sliotar above head height using strong hands and balanced body position.
